user.title: Ingress
user.description:
Local UI: each ingress appears on its own integration row. After setup, choose Add ingress.
Agent: connect to an already running external ingress agent.
YAML: manage panels in configuration.yaml.

my_agent.title: Ingress agent
my_agent.description: Enter the URL of your already running ingress agent.

import_yaml.title: Import YAML panels
import_yaml.description: Copy the current YAML panels into the local UI. Resolved !secret values, including headers and tokens, will be stored in the Home Assistant configuration entry. Further YAML edits will not update these panels. Confirm to import and switch modes; cancel to keep YAML unchanged.

data.confirm: Import panels and switch to local UI

user.title: Add ingress
user.description: Enter the panel address and sidebar details. Open Advanced to configure child panels, authentication, dynamic URLs, headers, and ordered response rewrites. Empty optional fields remove the saved setting. Header values and static tokens are stored in the Home Assistant configuration entry; static tokens remain valid until changed.

data_description.static_token: Creates a public access link that bypasses Home Assistant login. Leave empty to require login.
data_description.headers: Values are stored in the Home Assistant configuration entry.
data_description.tls_mode: For HTTPS ingress and subapp proxies only. Warning: ignoring certificate errors disables server identity verification. Configured credentials can reach an impersonating server.
data_description.tls_certificate: Required for provided certificate trust. Paste CA or server certificates, without private keys. Hostname, chain, and expiry verification still apply. Other panels keep their own trust settings.

data_description.url: Dynamic URLs use this address as their default. Proxy modes accept a host and port. Iframe and custom modes also accept a /relative URL.
data_description.require_admin: Controls sidebar visibility; it does not add backend authorization.

missing_parent.title: Ingress panels have missing parents
missing_parent.description: These panels are temporarily disabled, including their routes and tokens: {panels}. Missing parents: {parents}. Add the parent again with the same identifier, or edit the affected panels from their rows in Settings → Devices & services → Ingress. Their settings have been kept.
